summary: Art Wave C1 — 8 hand-drawn watercolor chaos-to-paint area restoration decals (4 chaos scribble/crumple/fizzy patches + 4 sunlit wildflower/clover/meadow/dew-sunbeam bloom accents) packed into a lean 1024x512 alpha-WebP atlas (`public/assets/restoration/restoration.webp`, 205.2 KB, q92, alpha_q 100, PSNR 42.74 dB).

prompts.chaosSheet: 2x2 grid of four isolated hand-drawn chaos decals on flat pure white #FFFFFF (loops/spirals, violet zigzag crosshatch over lavender wash, fizzy lavender bubbles/swirls/stars; bottom-left replaced by standalone organic crumple call). Dry purple-lavender crayon & watercolor smudge aesthetic, zero scenery, zero grid lines, zero text.
prompts.chaosCrumple: Single centered organic irregular-shaped hand-drawn crumpled-paper wrinkle smudge decal on pure flat white #FFFFFF, feathered cloud-like silhouette (zero rectangular border), soft taupe-lavender folded crease shadows and stray violet crayon ticks.
prompts.bloomFlora: 2x2 grid of isolated 3/4 overhead hand-painted watercolor-and-ink meadow flora ground decals on flat pure magenta #FF00FF matching Meadow Park concept style with warm sepia-brown #5B3530 ink contours and zero magenta/pink/purple inside flora (butter-yellow/cream daisies, golden-green four-leaf clovers, sky-blue forget-me-not & apricot buttercup sprig).
prompts.bloomDew: Single centered lineless warm honey-gold & ivory watercolor sparkle and sunbeam dew flourish decal on flat pure black #000000 matching VFX concept sheet top-right style.

processing: Crop chaos quadrants (TL chaos_scribble_loop, TR chaos_scribble_zigzag, BR chaos_fizzy_doodle) from chaos-sheet-raw.png plus full chaos-crumple-raw.png (chaos_crumple_patch); run tools/art/white-to-alpha.ts; trim, fit within 224x224, center on 256x256 transparent canvas.

Crop flora quadrants (TL bloom_wildflowers, TR bloom_clover_tuft, BL bloom_meadow_sprig) from bloom-flora-raw.png; run tools/art/key-alpha.ts --key #FF00FF --fuzz 22% --holes --despill none followed by tools/art/despill-edge.ts --key magenta --band 3; trim, fit within 224x224, center on 256x256 transparent canvas.
Run tools/art/black-to-alpha.ts on bloom-dew-raw.png (bloom_sunbeam_dew); trim, fit within 232x232, center on 256x256 transparent canvas.
Verify 0 non-zero alpha pixels on the 4 px outer border of all 8 frames; montage into 4x2 (1024x512) atlas and encode with cwebp -q 92 -alpha_q 100 -m 6 (verified PSNR 42.74 dB >= 42 dB).
